title: Copay and Coinsurance Rate Card: Pharmacy Benefit Plan Tiers 1 to 3
content:
Rate card for formulary tier 1 (generic), tier 2 (preferred brand) and tier 3 (non-preferred brand) under the Pharmacy Benefit Plan. For each tier a design sets a cost-share basis — a flat copay or a coinsurance — and the figures that go with it. A copay is a flat amount per 30-day retail supply. A coinsurance rate is a fraction of the claim's allowed amount, with an optional per-fill minimum and an optional per-fill maximum; 0.00 in a minimum column means no minimum, 0.00 in a maximum column means no per-fill maximum, and copay figures read 0.00 where the basis is coinsurance (and rates read 0% where the basis is copay).

| Plan design | Rounding of every computed member cost share |

| Northbridge Rx HSA Saver | Nearest cent |

| Northbridge Rx Plus | Nearest cent |

## Notes to the card

- Northbridge Rx HSA Saver is coinsurance on all three tiers, with no per-fill minimum or maximum on any of them.
- Northbridge Rx Basic is copay on tiers 1 and 2 and coinsurance on tier 3, where the 50% rate is held between a per-fill minimum of 75.00 and a per-fill maximum of 150.00.
- Northbridge Rx Value, Select, Plus and Premier are copay on all three tiers.
